questions.q: In which year did Morocco gain independence from France?
questions.why: Spain also gave up most of its zone that year.

questions.q: Who has been King of Morocco since 1999?
questions.why: He succeeded his father Hassan II.

questions.q: Which 1975 march sent 350,000 Moroccans into Western Sahara?
questions.why: It was organised by Hassan II.

questions.q: Which dynasty has ruled Morocco since the 1600s?
questions.why: It is one of the oldest ruling dynasties.

questions.q: Which Moroccan city has the world's oldest existing university?
questions.why: Al-Qarawiyyin was founded in 859.

questions.q: Which woman founded the University of al-Qarawiyyin?
questions.why: She used her inheritance to build it.

questions.q: Which famous traveller from Tangier visited much of the medieval world?
questions.why: He travelled for nearly 30 years.

questions.q: Which Berber dynasty founded Marrakesh around 1070?
questions.why: Marrakesh gave Morocco its name.

questions.q: Which king led Morocco to independence and was exiled by France in 1953?
questions.why: He returned in triumph in 1955.

questions.q: Which sultan built the imperial city of Meknes in the late 1600s?
questions.why: He ruled for 55 years.

questions.q: Which Roman city's ruins near Meknes are a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It has beautiful mosaics.

questions.q: What is the main Indigenous people of North Africa called?
questions.why: Tamazight became an official language in 2011.

questions.q: Which 1578 battle is called the Battle of the Three Kings?
questions.why: Three kings died in it.

questions.q: Which Saadian sultan built the El Badi Palace in Marrakesh?
questions.why: It was paid for partly with gold from West Africa.

questions.q: Which 1921 battle saw Rif fighters defeat a Spanish army?
questions.why: Abd el-Krim led the Rif forces.

questions.q: What is the capital of Morocco?
questions.why: Casablanca is the largest city.

questions.q: Which slow-cooked dish is named after its cone-shaped clay pot?
questions.why: It is often made with lamb and prunes.

questions.q: Which huge square in Marrakesh fills with food stalls at night?
questions.why: It is on UNESCO's heritage list.

questions.q: Which mountain range crosses Morocco?
questions.why: Toubkal is its highest peak.

questions.q: What is Morocco's currency?
questions.why: Its code is MAD.

questions.q: Which strait separates Morocco from Spain?
questions.why: It is about 14 km wide at its narrowest.

questions.q: Which team became the first African side to reach a World Cup semi-final, in 2022?
questions.why: They beat Spain and Portugal on the way.

questions.q: Which 'blue city' in the Rif is famous for its painted streets?
questions.why: Its houses are washed in shades of blue.

questions.q: Which huge mosque in Casablanca has a minaret over 200 m tall?
questions.why: Part of it stands over the Atlantic.

questions.q: Which sweet mint drink is served everywhere in Morocco?
questions.why: It is poured from a height.

questions.q: Which tree's nut oil is a Moroccan speciality?
questions.why: It grows mainly in the southwest.

questions.q: Which 1942 film is named after Morocco's biggest city?
questions.why: Humphrey Bogart starred.

questions.q: What is Morocco's highest mountain?
questions.why: It is 4,167 m high.

questions.q: Which coastal town is famous for gnawa music and windsurfing?
questions.why: It was once called Mogador.

questions.q: Which ancient fortified village in the south appears in many films?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.
